text: The CRDAO drives code review prices down through a bidding process and provides open access to anyone who qualifies rather than only members of the code review cartel.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709

isBasedOn.name: How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards

abstract: The CRDAO provides a decentralized community-driven code review process that utilizes a bidding process on code reviews to drive prices down. It provides open access for code reviews from anyone who qualifies – not just members of the code review cartel.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: a functioning code review DAO with decentralized governance
